title: World Cup Opens at Estadio Azteca as Protests Proceed Peacefully
detail: The 2026 FIFA World Cup opening ceremony took place at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, drawing massive crowds for the tournament kickoff. Protests in the city proceeded without disrupting the historic event, as large gatherings celebrated the opening game. Mexico City's security preparations held as fans from around the world filled the stadium and fan zones across the capital.
